description:
In the SyncApp project (already open in Android Studio), add a foreground service for background data synchronization.

Create a new Kotlin class `DataSyncService` in the package `com.example.syncapp.service` (file path: app/src/main/java/com/example/syncapp/service/DataSyncService.kt) that:

1. Extends `android.app.Service`
2. Creates a NotificationChannel with:
   - Channel ID: `data_sync_channel`
   - Channel name: `Data Sync`
   - Importance: IMPORTANCE_LOW
3. In `onStartCommand()`: calls `startForeground()` with a notification that has:
   - Notification ID: 1
   - Title: `Syncing Data`
   - Small icon: `android.R.drawable.ic_popup_sync`
   - Uses the `data_sync_channel` channel
   - Returns `START_STICKY`
4. In `onBind()`: returns `null`

Update `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` to:
1. Add permission: `<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE" />`
2. Add permission: `<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC" />`
3. Declare the service inside `<application>`: `<service android:name=".service.DataSyncService" android:foregroundServiceType="dataSync" android:exported="false" />`

The project must still build successfully after your changes. You can verify by building the project in Android Studio (Build > Make Project).
